title: Warm Crisp Greek Feta Gyro
description: A salty and crisp Greek dish featuring feta, double-fry KFC style, served in a cedar plank vessel, perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Double fry the chicken breast by frying it in olive oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes, then baking it in the oven for 15 minutes.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the gyro by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita bread, then adding the double fried chicken, diced tomato, and thinly sliced onion.
Crumble the feta cheese on top of the gyro.
Serve the gyro in a cedar plank vessel.
Drizzle olive oil over the gyro before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
